english.title: Refuse to give debtor / hirer the name and address of a credit reference agency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being

(A)_[a creditor,]_
(B)_[an owner,]_
(C)_[a negotiator,]_

failed, within 7 working days of receiving a request in writing, to give

(D)_[the debtor,]_
(E)_[the hirer,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), notice of the name and address of any credit reference agency from which you had, during the antecedent negotiations, applied for information about the financial standing of

(F)_[him]_
(G)_[her]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 157(1) and (3) of, and schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
